items.title: Nvidia Partner Vertiv Leads S&P 500 Gainers After Strong Earnings, Raised Outlook
items.author: Aaron McDade
items.highlights: Shares of Vertiv (VRT) were up 14% in recent trading, leading gainers on the S&P 500. The company reported adjusted earnings of $2.21 per share in the third quarter on revenue that grew more than 60% year-over-year to $4.31 billion. Both figures were well above estimates compiled by Visible Alpha. The Nvidia (NVDA) partner, which makes data center products including power and cooling equipment, said it expects fourth-quarter revenue of $4.31 billion to $4.51 billion and adjusted EPS between $2.22 and $2.28, with the midpoint of each range topping consensus projections. items.author: Gian Estrada
items.highlights: Orders grab the headline, but this quarter also dealt with the delivery worry. Back in July, Vertiv’s second-quarter sales of $3.27 billion landed below the $3.35 billion midpoint of its guidance, which management put down to timing shifts from temporary supply chain congestion and multi-phase projects. That’s exactly the kind of delay the market started pricing in across AI power stocks in October.
